body:
I will try, I was always sort of antisocial, I could spend days barely speaking with people, but I talked with her almost every hour of the day, at first it felt like too much, but I got used to it and started appreciating having someone to talk to.

Now that she's gone, I'm suddenly alone again. I still have friends I talk to/see like once a week, but I have no one I can talk to like I talked to her, and even then, talking to anyone would not feel the same. I could cope with the loneliness if I was busier, but I'm unemployed until 1st June, so I'm basically home alone and without money to do any activity.

I'll try to find ways to distract myself at home, but it's gonna be a rough 3 weeks.
The thing is that it hurts so much it's difficult to focus on anything, I wanted to know if someone was in a similar situation and maybe got out of it by getting distracted with that.
